title: How Yield Aggregator Composability Patterns Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    U[User deposits asset] --> V[Vault mints shares]
    V --> P["pricePerShare = totalAssets / totalSupply"]
    V --> S[Route capital to strategies]
    subgraph External Protocols
        S --> A[AMM LP positions]
        S --> L[Lending markets]
        S --> G[Gauges / restaking]
    end
    A --> H[Harvest reward tokens]
    L --> H
    G --> H
    H --> C[Swap rewards to principal]
    C --> CO[Auto-compound into principal]
    CO --> P
    P --> W[User withdraws at share price]

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    AT[Attacker] --> FL[Flash-loan capital]
    subgraph V1 Share Price Manipulation
        FL --> D[Distort external pool state]
        D --> DEP[Deposit at deflated price]
        DEP --> RE[Re-inflate pool then redeem]
        RE --> PR[Mint free shares]
    end
    AT --> HV[Front-run permissionless harvest]
    subgraph V3 MEV Sandwich
        HV --> SW["Unprotected swap amountOutMin = 0"]
        SW --> SAN[Sandwich every harvest]
    end
    AT --> FD[First-depositor donation]
    FD --> INF[Inflate price, round down victim]
    PR --> PROF[Drain honest depositors]
    SAN --> PROF
    INF --> PROF

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    ST[Strategy / Vault] --> Q{What state can move in-tx?}
    Q --> O[Use TWAP resistant oracle]
    O --> SP[Price shares off settled state]
    ST --> SL[Off-chain amountOutMin bound]
    SL --> CALM[Add calm-period deviation check]
    ST --> WL[Whitelist immutable strategies]
    WL --> GOV[Governance-gated, no arbitrary delegatecall]
    ST --> SEED[Seed deposit or virtual shares]
    SEED --> DON[Block donation inflation]
    SP --> SAFE[Composable yield, no free shares]
    CALM --> SAFE
    GOV --> SAFE
    DON --> SAFE
